name: How long does a re-stucco project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a re-stucco project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a re-stucco project can vary based on several factors, including the size of your home, the complexity of its architectural details, and weather conditions. Generally, a typical residential re-stucco project can take anywhere from one to three weeks from start to finish. This timeframe usually includes preparation, application of multiple stucco coats, and curing time. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: A re-stucco project typically takes one to three weeks, depending on home size, architectural complexity, and weather.
